objective: Implement transcript storage and a transcription provider abstraction so raw transcript, cleaned transcript, provider metadata, and failure states can be persisted without breaking the local meeting record.
success_criteria: Raw transcript, cleaned transcript, provider name/model, and failed transcription states can be persisted locally.
Transcript storage remains linked through the meeting and raw capture relationship.
Transcription is isolated behind one provider interface.
A failed provider response updates local records safely instead of breaking the meeting flow.
stop_conditions: The task requires remote provider credentials or live network execution.
The task requires UI shell work instead of local application flow and persistence.
The task requires destructive schema migration logic for live user data.
approval_gates: Changing scope from provider abstraction to live service integration
notes: Ticket sources: docs/implementation-tickets.md T11 and T12.
This slice provides local persistence and provider abstraction, not live provider execution wiring.
